actions.authority: district AI framework; draft policy in board committee
actions.summary: Draft emerging-technology policy covering AI advanced out of the board's policy committee after broad stakeholder outreach. The district's working framework points AI at teacher tasks - planning, feedback, administrative work - while student use stays more heavily monitored and is used mainly to teach transparency about AI.
actions.notes: Maryland's largest district. The operating framework is what this row records; a formal 'emerging technology' policy covering AI was advanced out of the board's policy committee after stakeholder outreach and has not had a board vote as of 2026-09-14. Driven by the Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act (signed May 2026), which gives every district 120 days from the state guidance issued after the February 2026 State Board presentation - a fall 2026 deadline. effective_from is the date the framework was described in press, not an adoption date. Prince George's County (pilots) and Frederick County (considering Gemini, forming a local AI advisory group) are candidate rows if dated sources turn up.
